title: Lanthanide Tetranuclear Cage and Mononuclear Cocrystalline Nitronyl Nitroxide Complex with Single-Molecule-Magnet Behavior

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of Dy(hfac)3·2H2O (81 mg, 0.1 mmol) in dry n-heptane (15 mL) was refluxed for 2 h and cooled to 60 °C. A solution of NITPhThio (58 mg, 0.2 mmol) in dry CH2Cl2 (6 mL) was added, and the mixture was refluxed for 1 h, cooled to room temperature, and filtered. Slow evaporation of the filtrate at 0–4 °C for about two weeks gave dark-green crystals of 1. The main text only states that evaporation of the filtrate from a CH2Cl2 solution of NITPhThio added to an n-heptane solution of Dy(hfac)3·2H2O formed dark-blue crystals, without quantities.
synthesis.temperature: reflux, then 60 °C, then room temperature; crystallization at 0–4 °C
synthesis.time: 2 h reflux of the metal precursor, 1 h reflux after ligand addition, about two weeks crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in dry solvent followed by filtration and refrigerated evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered, and slowly evaporated at 0–4 °C for about two weeks to give dark-green single crystals

properties.summary: Complex 1 is paramagnetic. Room-temperature χMT is close to one uncoupled Dy(III) ion plus two radicals, then falls on cooling with a small negative Weiss constant. AC data under zero field show no obvious slow magnetic relaxation.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; calculated uncoupled value 14.92 cm^3 K mol^-1 for one Dy(III) and two radicals

material_class.structural_family: μ3-OH tetrahedral Dy4 metallacage capped by IMPhThio radicals, cocrystallized with mononuclear Dy(hfac)3(NITPhThio)2

synthesis.procedure: A solution of mononuclear complex 1 (30 mg, 0.02 mmol) in dry CH2Cl2 (5 mL) was treated with equimolar Dy(hfac)3·2H2O (16 mg, 0.02 mmol) in dry n-heptane (15 mL). The mixture was refluxed for 3 h, cooled to room temperature, and filtered. The green solution was stored at 0–4 °C for about two weeks to give dark-green crystals of the cocrystal. During assembly, NITPhThio is reduced to IMPhThio in the tetranuclear cage. The main text states only that reaction of 1 with equimolar Dy(hfac)3·2H2O in heptane/dichloromethane gave crystals of 2, without numerical masses or volumes.
synthesis.temperature: reflux, then room temperature; crystallization at 0–4 °C
synthesis.time: 3 h reflux, about two weeks crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in dry CH2Cl2/n-heptane, filtration, refrigerated crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered, and stored at 0–4 °C for about two weeks to give dark-green crystals suitable for X-ray analysis

properties.summary: Complex 2 shows a declining χMT on cooling, consistent with Dy(III) MJ depopulation and/or antiferromagnetic coupling. It has no χ'' maxima at zero dc field, but under 5000 Oe it is a field-induced single-molecule magnet with an Orbach barrier; radical bridges in the cage are credited with improving the spin dynamics relative to mononuclear 1.
